تنضون (form I)
# تَنِضُّونَ (taniḍḍūna) /ta.nidˤ.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# تُنَضُّونَ (tunaḍḍūna) /tu.nadˤ.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
